settings.method: Per-channel DC removal and linear detrending, then FFT-domain zero-phase Butterworth magnitude response with 3-second reflection padding
settings.dc_and_detrend: Applied independently to each channel and valid span before filtering: subtract its mean DC offset and least-squares linear trend. The 0.5 Hz high-pass also attenuates remaining slow drift.
settings.signal_units: Capsule SDK raw-value units; the local SDK API exposes float values but does not document a physical unit. No conversion to volts or microvolts is applied.

filter_response_validation.method: Synthetic sine inputs, measured interior amplitude ratio versus analytic Butterworth response

artifact_rules.near_full_scale_candidate: Absolute raw sample >=0.399 native units, numerically near the user-supplied ±0.4 range; raw SDK units are unconfirmed, so this is a candidate rail flag only.
artifact_rules.large_amplitude: Absolute deviation greater than 8 robust MAD-based standard deviations from channel median.
artifact_rules.sudden_jump: One-sample change greater than 10 robust MAD-based standard deviations of the first difference.
artifact_rules.flatline_over_1s: Consecutive unchanged values lasting at least 1 second.
artifact_rules.timestamp_gap_or_order: Nonpositive interval or timestamp gap above 1.5 / 250 seconds.
artifact_rules.filter_edge: First and last 1 second of each valid filtering span.
artifact_rules.unfiltered_or_too_short: Samples that could not be filtered because the channel span was shorter than 5 seconds or contained invalid data.

settings.note: Artifact flags are screening aids, not proof that all artifacts or non-neural signals are removed. Music-related EEG cannot be isolated by filtering alone. Clean outputs retain every timestamp and blank only affected channel samples; unaffected channels and intervals are not discarded. Physical units remain unconfirmed, so outputs are not approved for segmentation.
